messages:
jenna_prodops: Quick FYI — the control-plane cert rotation maintenance window for Sat 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC needs a 45m extension due to a vendor KV migration rollback we just observed. Impact: some Dedicated customers in eu-west1 may see short token-generation spikes and 5-15s retries. No ongoing P0 yet but we want to be proactive. @alex_oncall can you take the oncall handoff and coordinate status page + customer comms? :warning:

ops-bot: Incident bot — scheduled_maintenance queued at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Ticket INC-5234 created. Auto-pager enabled for oncall group 'prod-oncall'.

alex_oncall: I'm taking this. Oncall handoff starts at 02:20 UTC for me. First steps: update status page to "degraded" for eu-west1, notify SLA tier A customers, and pull SRE in if latency doesn't stabilize within 15m. Can someone paste the quick mitigation runbook here?

lee_eng: Seen this pattern before — vendor rollback triggered a KV hot-key sweep that blows up latency. Short-term mitigation: enable prefix caching on serving pool and bump retry backoff for external KV reads. Patching now; will post commands.

lee_eng: ```bash
# temporary prefix caching on serving nodes
# run on serving-pool-eu-west1 leader
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/pools/serving-pool-eu-west1/cache -d '{"prefix_cache":true,"ttl_s":300}' 
# bump internal KV read backoff
kubectl set env deployment/kv-client BACKOFF_MULT=1.5 BACKOFF_MAX_MS=1000 -n redwood
```

sam_cs: CS note — prepping customer-facing template. We should call out expected window extension and immediate mitigation steps, link to status page, and escalation contact. Jenna, can you drop a ready-to-send template? I'll start triage list for impacted Dedicated accounts.

jenna_prodops: Draft customer notification (short version):
```
Subject: Redwood Inference — Maintenance extension in eu-west1 (March 21)

Hello —
We are continuing planned maintenance in eu-west1 (certificate rotation + vendor data migration). The window has been extended; you may experience brief increases in inference latency or transient retries for requests routed through eu-west1. Our engineering team has applied temporary prefix caching and is monitoring. Expected resolution: by 03:45 UTC.
If you rely on Dedicated capacity and see persistent issues, please reply to this thread or contact support@redwood.com (phone: +1-800-555-0123).
Thank you for your patience.
Redwood Inference Operations
```

statusbot: Statusbot — draft status update created: 
- Component: control-plane / routing (eu-west1)
- Status: Under Maintenance (extended)
- Public message scheduled in 10 minutes. Preview: "We are performing an extended maintenance window in eu-west1. Customers may see brief increases in latency and transient retries. We expect full recovery by 03:45 UTC."

alex_oncall: Updating the public status now and tagging SLA-A customers. @sam_cs please send Jenna's template to the impacted list and paste copy here when sent. I'll also coordinate with SRE if latencies don't drop within next 10m.

sam_cs: Sent to impacted accounts list and support queue. Email subject used: "Redwood Inference — maintenance extension (eu-west1)". Included escalation contact and link to status page.

lee_eng: Mitigation metrics: applied prefix_cache=true to serving-pool-eu-west1. Quick telemetry: median token latency reduced from ~420ms to ~95ms (preliminary), error rate down from 1.8% -> 0.4%. Will continue monitoring and roll back the change after stability.

ops-bot: Automation log — prefix_cache toggle applied by lee_eng at 2026-03-21T02:12:30Z. Telemetry capture started (metric ids: latency.token, kv.read_latency).

alex_oncall: Good mitigation delta. I'm continuing to monitor; will post hourly updates on the status page and a final completion notice once we verify full recovery. If anything degrades, I'll escalate to SRE lead. @statusbot please post a completion message when I mark this resolved.

jenna_prodops: Completion notice draft (to post when resolved):
```
Completed: maintenance in eu-west1 — 2026-03-21 03:37 UTC
Summary: The control-plane cert rotation encountered a vendor KV migration rollback that required a 45m extension. We applied temporary prefix caching and bumping KV client backoff which mitigated latency and errors.
Impact: brief increases in inference latency and transient retries for some Dedicated customers in eu-west1. No data loss.
Actions: Reverted temporary caching and validated recovery. Follow-ups: internal RCA and vendor postmortem scheduled.
If you continue to see issues, contact support@redwood.com.
```

statusbot: Acknowledged — will post completion when alex_oncall changes status to 'resolved'.

alex_oncall: Marking resolved now after 15m stable telemetry and follow-up checks. Posting completion to status page and closing pager. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

jenna_prodops: Closing thread after status page completion. Preparing RCA doc and vendor follow-up notes. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
